label: Crude birth rate
notes: Live births per 1,000 population. UN Demographic Yearbook Table 9 (2007-2024), plus the 1974-1978 prints of vanished states from the 1978 edition.

label: Life expectancy at age 60
notes: Years of life remaining at age 60, by sex. UN Demographic Yearbook Tables 21 and 22.

label: Maternal deaths
notes: Registered maternal deaths (a count). UN Demographic Yearbook Table 17, 2001-2022.

label: Maternal mortality ratio
notes: Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births. UN Demographic Yearbook Table 17, 2001-2022.

label: Road accident mortality per motor vehicle
notes: Road deaths per 10,000 registered motor vehicles. OECD / ITF IRTAD safety indicators, 1994-2024.

label: Abortion legalization year
notes: Year abortion was first legalized, one year per country.

label: Abortion rate
notes: Legally induced abortions, as a rate (per 1,000 women of reproductive age or per 100 live births).

label: Divorce legalization year
notes: Year divorce became legally available, one year per country.

label: Drug overdose mortality
notes: Deaths from drug overdose or drug use disorders per 100,000 inhabitants.

label: Mean years of schooling
notes: Average number of years of formal education completed by the population aged 25 and over.

label: PISA reading scores
notes: Mean PISA reading score of 15-year-old students.

label: PISA science scores
notes: Mean PISA science score of 15-year-old students.

label: Women's suffrage introduction year
notes: Year women obtained the right to vote in national elections, one year per country.

label: Youth suicide rate
notes: Deaths by suicide per 100,000 young people aged 15 to 24.
